title: Auto Detailing Business for Sale in Gudja, Malta
tagline: We are well-known car detailing business, specializing in top-notch valeting and ceramic coating services. - We offer a range of premium packages, including Super Valet, Supreme Valet, and Special, tailored to keep cars looking their best. - Our main customers are private vehicle owners who want professional cleaning, detailing, and long-term paint protection. - Over the past 2.5 years, we've served over 600 clients and built a loyal customer base in the community. - We have around 60 ceramic coating clients, with about 50 of them enrolled in a maintenance plan, paying €100 per service. - This maintenance plan generates consistent revenue and encourages repeat visits, enhancing customer relationships. - The business is under a sole proprietor, and the industry doesn't need any specific license or certificate. - The promoter himself works on the ceramic coating and works 6 to 7 hours per day. Works on 2 cars every day on average income of EUR 200 each day.
